definitions.explanation: A grammatical term referring to adjectives in Japanese. In traditional Japanese grammar, this specifically refers to i-adjectives (words ending in い).

examples.japanese: {形容詞|けいようし}は{名詞|めいし}を{修飾|しゅうしょく}する。
「{美|うつく}しい」は{形容詞|けいようし}だ。
{日本語|にほんご}の{形容詞|けいようし}は{活用|かつよう}する。

notes:
{形容詞|けいようし} is a Japanese grammar term meaning "adjective." In traditional Japanese grammar ({国文法|こくぶんぽう}), it specifically refers to い-adjectives — words like {高|たか}い, {大|おお}きい, and {美|うつく}しい that end in い and conjugate.

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
- {形容詞|けいようし}: い-adjective (conjugates: {高|たか}い → {高|たか}くない)
- {形容動詞|けいようどうし}: な-adjective (uses だ/な: {静|しず}かだ, {静|しず}かな)
In school grammar and textbooks, these are treated as separate parts of speech.

RELATED GRAMMAR TERMS:
- {動詞|どうし}: verb
- {名詞|めいし}: noun
- {副詞|ふくし}: adverb
- {助詞|じょし}: particle
- {活用|かつよう}: conjugation
